tool_args.rationale: The open-branch measurements resolve the pilot's principal gradient ambiguity. Fit the recalled smooth, subcritical sink-gradient law numerically and test it on fresh observations; the supercritical behavior remains unidentified.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: It has no sink-gradient dependence, whereas the open-branch observations show a substantial gradient effect.
The recalled saturating sink-gradient mechanism directly captures both the concave substrate response and decreasing response with gradient; fresh confirmation will test it.
All observed gradients are below the recalled critical range, so its threshold and strength cannot be fitted from these rows. No high-gradient probe is listed in the available menu.
The remaining ambiguity concerns the unobserved high-gradient branch, not fine temporal resolution.
It is irrelevant to identifying the response law.
